SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'STOCK_MONTH' THEN A.BASE_VAL END) AS STOCK_MONTH , MAX(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'SALES_DEMAND_WEEK' THEN A.BASE_VAL END) AS SALES_DEMAND_WEEK , MAX(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'SOM_MONTH' THEN A.BASE_VAL END) AS SOM_MONTH , MAX(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'SALES_RESULT_MONTH' THEN A.BASE_VAL END) AS SALES_RESULT_MONTH , MAX(CASE WHEN A.TYPE = 'INBOUND_DEMAND_WEEK' THEN A.BASE_VAL END) AS INBOUND_DEMAND_WEEK FROM ( SELECT 'STOCK_MONTH' AS TYPE , MAX(STOCK_YM) AS BASE_VAL FROM STOCK_TABLE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SALES_DEMAND_WEEK' AS TYPE , MAX(DEMAND_WEEK) AS BASE_VAL FROM SALES_DEMAND_TABLE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SOM_MONTH' AS TYPE , MAX(SOM_YM) AS BASE_VAL FROM SOM_TABLE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SALES_RESULT_MONTH' AS TYPE , MAX(RESULT_YM) AS BASE_VAL FROM SALES_RESULT_TABLE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'INBOUND_DEMAND_WEEK' AS TYPE , MAX(DEMAND_WEEK) AS BASE_VAL FROM INBOUND_DEMAND_TABLE ) A
